integrity_statement: An analytical proof establishes the limit; the executable only checks finite instances. The cited finite stationary product law is acknowledged as previously known; the asserted extension concerns the near-equal-rate crossover. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary equilibrium for N-site connected symmetric exchange networks; piecewise-constant donor rates with logarithmic contrast tau/N, fixed kappa,r,tau, and K_N=floor(kappa N^2), L_N=floor(rK_N). No mixing-time or general-rate theorem. Older ensemble-equivalence priority risk remains.
title: Sharp weak-asymmetry transition in capped-debt exchange equilibria
